findings.title: `deleteCacheMutation` does not invalidate `connectedCalendars` query after deleting cache
findings.body: `disconnectMutation` invalidates `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` in `onSettled`, but `deleteCacheMutation` (lines 42-50) does not invalidate the `connectedCalendars` query. When `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper` renders without an `onChanged` callback (or with one that doesn't refetch `connectedCalendars`), deleting the cache leaves the stale `cacheUpdatedAt` in the React Query cache, so the dropdown continues showing the old cache status and the "Delete cached data" action until the page is reloaded.

findings.title: `prisma.selectedCalendar.updateMany` with an empty `data` object does not update `updatedAt`
findings.body: Line 1024 calls `await SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` with the comment `// Update SelectedCalendar.updatedAt for all calendars under this credential`. Unlike `prisma.selectedCalendar.update`, Prisma's `updateMany` does not automatically inject `@updatedAt` when `data` is `{}` (or at all unless `updatedAt` is explicitly passed in `data`), and an empty `data: {}` becomes a no-op in Prisma. If `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt` needs to be bumped, `updatedAt: new Date()` must be passed explicitly in `data` (or the call removed if `CalendarCache.updatedAt` has superseded it).

findings.title: `connectedCalendarsHandler` bypasses `CalendarCache.init` feature-flag check
findings.body: Other callers in the codebase initialize the calendar cache via `await CalendarCache.init(null)`, which checks the `calendar-cache` feature flag and returns `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` when the feature is disabled. Here `new CalendarCacheRepository()` is instantiated directly (line 28), so `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` will query the `CalendarCache` table and surface cache status/actions in the UI even when the `calendar-cache` feature flag is disabled (making the new `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` method on `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` unused).
